faq.q: How much do Core Web Vitals affect rankings?
faq.a: They are a real but small signal, mostly acting as a tiebreaker between similar pages. Content relevance matters far more. Fix them for conversions as much as for rankings.

faq.q: Why does my score differ between tools?
faq.a: PageSpeed Insights lab tests simulate a slow device. Search Console reports real visitors. The field data is what Google uses.

faq.q: Can a WordPress site pass Core Web Vitals?
faq.a: Yes, but it needs work - lean theme, few plugins, optimised images and decent hosting. Passing by default is unusual on WordPress.
